requirements.heading: Areas of Study
notes: Choose additional upper division restricted electives in biological science relevant to the student's interest chosen in consultation with a BASC advisor to achieve a total of 39 or more units. At least one of the courses taken to fulfill these requirements must include laboratory or field components in applying skills to real research scenarios. Students must meet at least 6 hours per week of laboratory and field components through their restricted electives.
Include at least one course from the Biodiversity area of study and two courses from the Advanced Evolution & Ecology areas of study below.

Note: A maximum of 4 units of variable-unit courses (numbered 192, 198, 199) may be applied to upper division elective unit requirements, but not to the upper division laboratory requirement. Courses numbered 197T are not applicable to the upper division elective unit requirement.
